version.sealNotKept: Signed: the seal is not kept yet. Keep it to file the proof with the version.
version.title: New DVR version
version.subtitle: Freeze the consultant's PDF and send it for signature
version.frozen_one: {version} is frozen and waits for {count} signature.
version.frozen_other: {version} is frozen and waits for {count} signatures.
version.sendNote: Nothing is sent to anyone: each signer signs on this page, or the safety officer records the paper they signed.
version.newAssessmentHint: One assessment per site or production unit. Add it, then freeze its first version.
version.assessmentNameHint: The site or production unit it covers.
version.nextReviewHint: As the assessment or the consultant says: no interval is built in.
version.recordFailed: The assessment could not be read
version.fingerprinting: Computing the fingerprint on this device…
version.pdfHint: The PDF exactly as the consultant delivered it (up to 50 MB). Its fingerprint is computed here before it is sent.
version.hazardsLater: Building a version from structured hazards comes later.
version.label: Version label
version.authorInHouseHint: Who wrote it in the company.
version.summaryHint: What changed since the version in force (new machine, new room, a review after an incident).
version.signersAfter: Choose the assessment first: the signers come from the safety organisation of its site.
version.signersNote: The signers are fixed when the version is frozen. The certain date is the day of the last signature.
version.freezeExplain: Freezing keeps the PDF exactly as it is, with its fingerprint and the time: the version's seal. It never changes afterwards; a change is a new version.

versions.lead: Every version with the proof of its date. Superseded and withdrawn versions are kept, never deleted.

move.evidenceHint: Optional: what was done and where the proof is. Photos or a report can go with it.

moveNote.DONE: The safety officer then verifies it.
moveNote.CANCELLED: A cancelled measure stays in the plan with the reason.

evidence.title: Evidence
evidence.hint: PDF or photos, up to 25 MB each.

measure.final: This measure is {status}: only its note can change.
measure.whatHint: What is to be done ("Guard on the clicking press").
measure.rolesAfter: Choose the assessment first: its site's roles.
measure.ownerHint: Someone who reads the safety pages; they move it themselves.
measure.costHint: Optional; seen only by people with the cost right.

measure.noVersion: No version yet: freeze the DVR first.
measure.versionDefault: The version in force (else the one waiting)
measure.incidentNote: A measure from an incident is added from the incident's record.

sheet.noKit: No PPE in the kit yet.

sheet.catalogueFailed: The catalogue could not be read

impact.title: What this changes
impact.reading: Reading what this changes for the people in the role…
impact.summary_one: {count} person is in the role. Applying writes the sheet; the training, PPE and visit lists follow by themselves.
impact.summary_other: {count} people are in the role. Applying writes the sheet; the training, PPE and visit lists follow by themselves.
impact.nobody: Nothing changes for the people in the role ({count}); only the sheet changes.
impact.COURSE_NEEDED_one: {count} person now needs {course} ({already} already hold it)
impact.COURSE_NEEDED_other: {count} people now need {course} ({already} already hold it)
impact.COURSE_NOT_NEEDED_one: {course} is no longer asked of {count} person
impact.COURSE_NOT_NEEDED_other: {course} is no longer asked of {count} people
impact.KIT_TO_ISSUE_one: {count} person gets {quantity} × {item} in their kit ({already} already hold it)
impact.KIT_TO_ISSUE_other: {count} people get {quantity} × {item} in their kit ({already} already hold it)
impact.KIT_REMOVED_one: {item} leaves the kit of {count} person (nothing is taken back)
impact.KIT_REMOVED_other: {item} leaves the kit of {count} people (nothing is taken back)
impact.VISITS_NEEDED_one: {count} person gets a visit every {months} months
impact.VISITS_NEEDED_other: {count} people get a visit every {months} months
impact.VISITS_NEEDED_DOCTOR_one: {count} person gets health visits (the doctor sets how often)
impact.VISITS_NEEDED_DOCTOR_other: {count} people get health visits (the doctor sets how often)
impact.VISITS_NOT_NEEDED_one: {count} person no longer needs health visits for this role
impact.VISITS_NOT_NEEDED_other: {count} people no longer need health visits for this role

sign.gone: This signature is no longer asked.

sign.name: Your name and surname
sign.nameHint: As the safety organisation names you.

sign.paperNameHint: The holder of the role, as written.
sign.paperDayHint: From {date} (the day it was frozen) to today.
sign.scanHint: PDF or a photo, up to 25 MB.
sign.doneComplete: {role} signed: every signature is in. Certain date {date}.
sign.sealed: The seal is kept with the version.

withdraw.title: Withdraw {version}
withdraw.explain: A version waiting for its signatures can be withdrawn. It stays in the list with the reason, never deleted.

editAssessment.hint: Its name, the next review, a note.
editAssessment.reviewHint: The day a person sets: the law asks a review after significant changes, no fixed interval is built in.

plan.burnNote: Whether the plan is moving: the open measures at the end of each week of the last year.

law.dvr: The employer assesses every risk and keeps the risk assessment document (DVR) with a certain date.
law.versions: The document carries a certain date, signed by the employer, the RSPP, the RLS and the occupational doctor.
law.plan: The measures to take, with who does them and when, are part of the document.
law.review: The assessment is reviewed after significant changes, incidents or what health surveillance finds.
law.roleSheet: Each role's risks are assessed: the sheet of the role says them.
law.kit: The employer gives the PPE each role needs and says when to wear it.
law.training: Each worker gets the training their role asks, within the deadline.
law.surveillance: The occupational doctor visits the workers whose risks ask for it, as often as they set.

stepUp.title: Confirm it is you
stepUp.sentence: Signing a version of the risk assessment asks a fresh code from your authenticator app.
stepUp.cancelled: Not signed: the code was not given.

problem.wrong: That code is wrong or already used. Type the code your app shows now.
problem.locked: Too many tries: wait a few minutes.
problem.unavailable: The code could not be checked: try again.

notice.measureGone: That measure is no longer there.
notice.frozen: {version} of {assessment} frozen: waiting for its signatures.
notice.signedComplete: {version} has every signature: it is in force.
notice.sealSame: The seal was already kept (document v{number}).

held.sign: Your role does not sign the risk assessment.
held.sheets: Your role does not keep the role sheets (safety officer).
held.upload: Your role does not upload files.
held.files: Your role does not open files: ask for the files right to see the PDF.
held.company: Choose a company in the top bar first.
held.noAssessment: Add the current DVR first: a measure belongs to an assessment.
held.title: Say what is to be done.
held.riskLong: The risk or area: at most 300 characters.
held.cost: A cost is an amount from 0, with at most two decimals.
held.fileLarge: The PDF is larger than 50 MB.
held.author: Name the author.
held.notWaiting: This version is not waiting for signatures.
held.notYourRole: Only the holder of the role signs it here, signed in as themselves.
held.signerName: Type the name on the paper.
held.tooManyItems: At most 60 risks and surveillance needs.
held.kitTwice: This item is in the kit already: one line per item.
held.courseTwice: The role asks this course already: one line per course.
held.withinDays: From 0 to 365 days, or empty: before starting.
held.surveillanceNeed: Name the surveillance need first (the risk that asks for visits).
held.codeShape: Letters, digits and . _ / - only, at most 20.

refusal.SITE_OTHER_COMPANY: That site is of another company.
refusal.NAME_TAKEN: That site already has an assessment of that name.
refusal.DUE_TOO_FAR: That day is more than ten years ahead: check the year.
refusal.FILE_NOT_READY: The file is not ready (still checked, or not a file of this assessment): try again in a moment.
refusal.NOT_PDF: The DVR is a PDF: choose the PDF file.
refusal.FROZEN_ALREADY: This PDF is frozen already as another version.
refusal.VERSION_WAITING: A version is already waiting for signatures: withdraw it or finish its signatures first.
refusal.NO_EMPLOYER: Nobody holds the employer's role at this site today: appoint the employer in the safety organisation first.
refusal.NOT_AWAITING: This version is not waiting for signatures any more.
refusal.NOT_SIGNED: Not every signer has signed yet.
refusal.NOT_A_SIGNER: This role does not sign this version.
refusal.NO_APPOINTMENT: Nobody holds this role on that day.
refusal.SIGNED_IN_FUTURE: The day on the paper cannot be after today.
refusal.SIGNED_BEFORE_FROZEN: The day on the paper cannot be before the version was frozen.
refusal.NAME_MISMATCH: The name is not the holder's of the role.
refusal.NOT_THE_SIGNER: Only the holder of the role signs here, signed in as themselves.
refusal.SAME_PERSON: This person has signed this version under another role already.
refusal.SCAN_MISSING: Add the scan of the signed paper first.
refusal.ROLE_SHEET_OTHER_SITE: A role of another site cannot be named.
refusal.OWNER_NOT_ALLOWED: That person cannot own a measure (they do not read the safety pages).
refusal.VERSION_OTHER_ASSESSMENT: That version is of another assessment.
refusal.SOURCE_NOT_FOUND: The source of the measure is not there.
refusal.MEASURE_FINAL: This measure is closed: only its note changes.
refusal.BAD_MOVE: That move is not possible from its present state.

sheetRefusal.SITE_OTHER_COMPANY: That site is of another company.

sheetRefusal.ARCHIVED: This role is archived: put it back in use first.

sheetRefusal.PPE_ITEM_NOT_AVAILABLE: That PPE item is not in the company's catalogue any more.

sheetRefusal.IMPACT_CHANGED: Something changed meanwhile: here is what this changes now.
